info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v3-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Credit Check API provides a streamlined way to retrieve credit check results for credit card applications. This endpoint allows authorized users to access the status and details of submitted applications, ensuring a quick response for processing approvals. Typical consumers include financial institutions and lending companies that require real-time verification for underwriting decisions. By utilizing this API, businesses can efficiently manage application reviews and enhance their decision-making process regarding credit issuance.

get.summary: Retrieve credit check information for applications
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed credit check data associated with specific applications. It returns the current status and results of the credit checks performed, enabling informed decisions based on the creditworthiness of applicants.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a credit check on a specified application. This payload should include all necessary details required for processing the credit check.

200.description: Successful retrieval of credit check information.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.title: Credit Check Request Body
ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: This schema represents the request body for the credit check operation. It is expected to be a string that contains the necessary request data.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.title: Credit Check Response

status.description: Indicates whether the credit check was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the credit check request.

resultId.description: The ID of the credit check result.

state.description: The current state of the credit check.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the credit check, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the credit check result.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: The response object for a credit check operation, containing the status, reference number, result ID, state, processing time, message, and audit details.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the credit check.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the credit check was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the credit check process was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Information regarding the creation and automation of the credit check process.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps in monitoring performance and optimizing response times.
